channel.title: IT Tools Gems
channel.description: IT tools watch for a 3D studio — render farm, storage, backup, deployment, network, security — open source first.

item.title: wg-easy 15.5.0
item.description: The web UI to run and manage a WireGuard server in Docker ships 15.5.0 (Oct 24): Node.js security fixes, AmneziaWG 3.1, a configurable interface name, trusted proxies, and peer endpoints in Prometheus metrics. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Pangolin 1.25.3
item.description: The tunneled reverse proxy, a self-hosted alternative to a VPN for exposing your services, follows the 1.25 series (HTTP redirects, mTLS, machine roles) with 1.25.3 (Oct 23): Node updated for a vulnerability, faster client connections. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OliveTin 3000.21.0
item.description: OliveTin puts your shell scripts behind web buttons, handy to let the team restart a service without SSH. 3000.21.0 (Oct 24) adds -syntaxcheck to validate the config and -startuptrace, and surfaces config errors in the UI. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: ZITADEL 4.20.0
item.description: The open source identity provider (SSO, OIDC, SAML) reaches 4.20.0 (Oct 22): a Go 1.26 build that rejects certificates chaining through the compromised eMudhra intermediates, so check your SMTP and external IdPs before upgrading. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Cockpit 370
item.description: The web admin console for Linux servers ships release 370 (Oct 22): storage management now recognizes TPM2 key slots on encrypted volumes and supports UTF-8 mount points. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: JuiceFS 1.4.2
item.description: The distributed POSIX file system built on S3 storage ships 1.4.2 (Oct 22): no more bad reads after object storage timeouts, SQL garbage collection deleting live data, or losses from stale transaction retries. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: PatchMon 2.1.6
item.description: Open source (AGPL) platform to track and deploy security updates across a Linux fleet from a web UI: agents, validation, scheduled patches, history. 2.1.6 (Oct 17) fixes installs behind Traefik + CrowdSec. Found via Self-Host Weekly, Oct 23.

item.title: Coolify 4.5.0
item.description: The self-hosted PaaS reaches 4.5.0 (Oct 23): server patching (beta) with automatic security updates, a fleet metrics page, a file browser, passkey sign-in, and an automatic database backup before updates. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Homebox 0.27.1
item.description: The self-hosted inventory tool (hardware, cables, spare parts) ships 0.27.1 (Oct 23), a security release patching the Node.js "Node2Shell" flaw; the team advises updating as soon as possible. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: SeaweedFS 4.49
item.description: The distributed S3-compatible object/file store ships 4.49 (Oct 23): remote cache eviction under disk pressure, vacuum that reclaims full read-only volumes, and IAM roles managed through the API. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: MeshCentral 1.3.0
item.description: The open source remote management and control tool for workstations hits 1.3.0 (Oct 21): default agent binaries now come from pinned GitHub releases, and the server no longer hangs when GitHub is unreachable. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Trivy 0.76.1
item.description: The vulnerability scanner (images, repos, IaC) ships 0.76.1 (Oct 21) after the eMudhra intermediate CA compromise: binaries built with Go 1.27.3 and images with an updated CA store. Upgrade and redeploy. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Atuin 18.24.2
item.description: The synced, encrypted shell history ships 18.24.2 (Oct 22): daemon, pty-proxy and config path fixes. If you self-host the server, use Docker image 18.24.2-1 (eMudhra certificates). Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: OpenCue 1.37.0
item.description: Featured before at 1.34: the render farm manager ships 1.37.0 (Oct 21), focused on Maestro at scale, a snappier CueGUI, configurable retries and OpenCueWeb/REST Docker images. DB migrations: back up first. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Prometheus 3.15.1
item.description: Security update for the metrics engine (Oct 21): images now distrust the compromised eMudhra CAs, built with Go 1.27.3, plus HTTP/2 fixes. Worth rolling out on your monitoring stack. Found via the prometheus/prometheus GitHub release.

item.title: Arcane 2.17.0
item.description: This open source web UI for managing Docker adds native Podman support, hostname configuration and a delay before auto-updating newly available images (Oct 21). Found via the getarcaneapp/arcane GitHub release.

item.title: Pocket ID 2.19
item.description: The passkey-based OIDC provider ships 2.19 (Oct 21): forced email verification, login notifications, plus security fixes (LDAP DN collision, email enumeration). Found via the pocket-id/pocket-id v2.19.0 GitHub release.

item.title: OpenTofu 1.13.2
item.description: The open source Terraform fork ships 1.13.2 (Oct 21): filters compromised intermediate certificates, fixes possible CPU exhaustion in tofu init against a malicious HTTP/2 server, and destroy crashes. Found via the GitHub release.

item.title: Snipe-IT 8.8.1
item.description: The asset and license manager ships 8.8.1 (Oct 20): built-in label editor, bulk actions and archiving, much richer Intune sync (28 fields). Requires PHP 8.2+. Found via the snipe/snipe-it GitHub release.

item.title: Docker Engine 29.9.2
item.description: Docker 29.9.2 (Oct 20) moves to Go 1.26.10, which rejects 8 compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates: a registry relying on them will make pulls and pushes fail. Check your private registry. Found via the moby/moby GitHub release.

item.title: Syncthing 2.1.7
item.description: Seen as an RC on Oct 16, Syncthing 2.1.7 is now stable (Oct 21): SQLite fixes, bad network data handled as errors instead of panics, and receive-only folder reconciliation fixed. Found via the syncthing/syncthing GitHub release.

item.title: Healthchecks 5.0
item.description: The cron and scheduled-job monitor (backups, render scripts) hits 5.0 (Oct 20): the Docker image swaps uWSGI for gunicorn (GUNICORN_WORKERS) and restarts the whole container if a process crashes. Check your compose. Found via the healthchecks/healthchecks GitHub release.

item.title: Warpgate 0.30.0
item.description: Seen on Oct 13 as a beta, the SSH/RDP/HTTP bastion goes stable (Oct 19): Vault/OpenBao secrets, on-the-fly signed SSH certs, OIDC back-channel logout and 4 vulns fixed (TOTP MFA, admin CSRF). Found via the warp-tech/warpgate GitHub release.

item.title: LibreNMS 26.10.1
item.description: Open source SNMP network monitoring: 26.10.0 (Oct 19) fixes about fifteen vulns (XSS, API permissions), drops collectd and adds Nutanix storage and PDU outlets; 26.10.1 (Oct 20) reverts an issue with old fping. Found via the librenms/librenms GitHub releases.

item.title: uv 0.13.2
item.description: Astral’s ultra-fast Python manager ships 0.13.2 (Oct 19): a much leaner resolver on big dependency graphs, retried network requests, and URL credentials no longer leaking into logs. Found via the astral-sh/uv GitHub release.

item.title: Gitea 28.2.0
item.description: Your self-hosted Git forge ships 28.2.0 (Oct 18): about thirty fixes, including LFS OID validation, checked OpenID state, a patched golang.org/x/net and sturdier Actions. Found via the go-gitea/gitea GitHub release.

item.title: mise 2026.10.14
item.description: The CLI tool and task manager adds (Oct 18) a global config.override.toml that beats project config, mise config explain, and per-category paranoid mode. Heads-up: an unknown tool option now fails the install. Found via the jdx/mise GitHub release.

item.title: Windmill 1.841.0
item.description: The open source self-hosted scripts and workflows platform ships 1.841.0 (Oct 18): workers authenticated by workload identity token, an allowlist for private MCP servers and a gVisor compat mode for the nsjail sandbox. Found via the windmill-labs/windmill GitHub release.

item.title: Pi-hole 6.5 / FTL 6.8
item.description: Your ad-blocking DNS ships Core 6.5 and FTL 6.8 (Oct 17): about a dozen flaws fixed, including command execution and root writes (CVSS 7.8), plus a faster gravity database. Found via the pi-hole/pi-hole GitHub release.

item.title: Homepage 2.6.0
item.description: The Homepage service dashboard moves to 2.6.0 (Oct 17) with a rewritten auth layer that fixes an authentication bypass through a Next.js header (GHSA-qxcr-4rv3-v23r, high severity 7.5). Found via the gethomepage/homepage GitHub release.

item.title: RustFS 1.0.2
item.description: S3 object storage in Rust (Apache 2.0), a MinIO alternative: 1.0.2 (Oct 16) caps memory on multipart copies, speeds up multipart I/O and fixes ListParts pagination; 1.0.3 (Oct 17) only touches the console. Found via the rustfs/rustfs GitHub release.

item.title: ntfy 2.31.1
item.description: Self-hosted push notifications for your render or backup alerts: 2.31.1 (Oct 17) fixes the database overload that forced ntfy.sh to roll back, and now tolerates a newer schema on rollback. Found via the binwiederhier/ntfy GitHub release.

item.title: Starship 1.27.0
item.description: The cross-platform Starship shell prompt ships 1.27.0 (Oct 17): Jujutsu (jj) modules, a right prompt in Bash via Flyline and two flaws fixed, including a git call that skipped the repository ownership check. Found via the starship/starship GitHub release.

item.title: GitLab 19.4.2 (critical patch)
item.description: If you host GitLab: 19.4.2 (Oct 12, also 19.3.5 and 19.2.8) fixes a CVSS 10 flaw that allows unauthenticated code execution on the server through a booby-trapped CI/CD regex. Apply it fast. Found via Self-Host Weekly.

item.title: UniGetUI 2026.3.2
item.description: Graphical interface for WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop or pip on Windows workstations. 2026.3.2 (Oct 15) adds an experimental catalog of approved software, with pinned versions, that users install in one click.

item.title: Homelable 3.6.0
item.description: Interactive map of your infrastructure (network, racks, services) with live status, network scans and built-in docs. 3.6.0 (Oct 7) lets you add images and PDFs to the docs and update an entry from a scan. Found via Self-Host Weekly.

item.title: Wazuh 4.14.9
item.description: Open source SIEM/XDR for monitoring workstations and servers. 4.14.9 (Oct 15) hardens the Linux binaries (PIE, RELRO, stack canary), closes idle enrollment connections and unblocks the vulnerability scanner.

item.title: NetBird 0.81.0
item.description: Open source mesh VPN (WireGuard) to link the farm, NAS and workstations. 0.81.0 (Oct 15) adds Certificate posture checks (proof of private key), nblink (HTTP forwarding without root) and path-based access on the reverse proxy.

item.title: Sentry Self-Hosted 26.10.0
item.description: Self-hostable error/observability platform. 26.10.0 (Oct 16) moves Postgres 14→18 (snapshot recommended before upgrading), pushes distroless images and adds regex log search.

item.title: Traefik 3.7.15
item.description: Reverse proxy / ingress for cleanly exposing studio services. 3.7.15 (Oct 15) rejects CONNECT requests before the muxer (hardening) and fixes auth-tls on the ingress-nginx side.

item.title: Bitwarden 2026.10.0
item.description: Self-hostable password vault for the studio. 2026.10.0 (Oct 14) lets you share items via temporary links and configure the lifetime of access tokens.

item.title: Headscale 0.29.5
item.description: Open source Tailscale-compatible controller for a self-hosted mesh VPN. 0.29.5 (Oct 13) fixes steering via exit nodes, ACL races and ghost peers on Android.

item.title: Syncthing 2.1.7-rc.2
item.description: Encrypted P2P asset sync between workstations and NAS. RC 2.1.7-rc.2 (Oct 13) polishes the 2.1 line (GUI groups, HTTPS CONNECT proxies, optional block indexing). Test outside production.

item.title: Rackula 26.10.1
item.description: Self-hostable rack planner (Docker/LXC) for documenting studio equipment. 26.10.1 (Oct 13) measures devices in mm, exports patches as CSV and pins libexpat (CVE-2026-93990).

item.title: Pulse 6.6.0-rc.1
item.description: Self-hosted monitoring for Proxmox, TrueNAS, Docker and Kubernetes (ideal for farm/NAS). RC1 of 6.6 (Oct 15) merges alerts and charts in the detail views, clarifies backup coverage and simplifies agent installation. Test outside production.

item.title: OpenLIT GPU Collector 1.0.0
item.description: Lightweight OpenTelemetry collector (Go) for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPU metrics — useful on render nodes. 1.0.0 (Oct 13) fixes multi-GPU/CUDA and per-pod process attribution, with no DCGM or proprietary agent.

item.title: Authentik 2026.8.4
item.description: Open source SSO/IdP to secure studio apps and access. 2026.8.4 (Oct 14) fixes SAML (PEM metadata), the proxy outpost (HTTP/2, JWKS), SCIM and duration validation — a maintenance patch to apply.

item.title: Marmot 0.11.1
item.description: Open source data catalog (MIT) to inventory databases, APIs, queues and pipelines. Found via awesome-selfhosted (added Oct 4); 0.11.1 (Oct 11) polishes the UI and fixes image auth and per-team webhooks.

item.title: imagor 1.9.10
item.description: Go server/library (libvips) for resizing, cropping and converting images on the fly — handy for asset previews. Found via awesome-selfhosted; 1.9.10 (Oct 14) adds nested path sources and moves to Go 1.27 / vips 8.18.

item.title: NetBox 4.7.3
item.description: Source of truth for the network inventory and DCIM (switches, IPs, racks) of a studio’s equipment. 4.7.3 (Oct 13) speeds up the REST API (prefetch, config context) and adds a location filter on power feeds.

item.title: Bacularis 7.0.0
item.description: Open source web interface for Bacula (studio/NAS backups). 7.0.0 (Oct 9) adds ransomware detection to Restore Verification, by analysing the data actually restored during restore tests.

item.title: Grafana 13.2.4
item.description: Dashboards and alerts for monitoring the farm, NAS and workstations. 13.2.4 (Oct 13) fixes four CVEs (2026-15577, 33374, 93294, 95502) and hardens alerting OAuth2 redirects.

item.title: Keycloak 26.8.1
item.description: Self-hostable SSO/IAM for the studio’s equipment. The 26.8 line (Oct 1, patch 26.8.1 on the 13th) makes SCIM and multi-cluster without an external cache supported, and fixes CVE-2026-15943 on the client secret of OIDC IdPs.

item.title: Mother-of-All-Self-Hosting
item.description: Ansible playbook (AGPL) for deploying services in Docker containers on a personal or studio server. Found via awesome-selfhosted (added Oct 9); a very active project (hundreds of commits/month).

item.title: Rustrak 0.16.3
item.description: Sentry SDK-compatible error server, ~32 MB at rest with SQLite. Found via awesome-selfhosted; 0.16.3 (Oct 12) aligns PostgreSQL ingest (NUL, lengths) to avoid 500s on real payloads.

item.title: Unraid 7.4.0-rc1
item.description: NAS OS (paid beyond the free tier) for storage and Docker containers. RC1 of 7.4 (Oct 8) shows Mover progress, a task tray and persistent Docker multi-network, and broadens Wi-Fi support. Test outside production.

item.title: Beszel 0.21.0
item.description: Lightweight server monitoring (CPU, Docker, alerts), ideal for farm nodes. 0.21.0 (Oct 2) adds Wi-Fi, TLS expiry for HTTPS monitors, systemd logs, network comparison and a list of pending packages.

item.title: VictoriaMetrics 1.154.0
item.description: Prometheus-compatible metrics database, lightweight for monitoring a render farm and NAS. 1.154.0 (released Oct 12) fixes two flaws (vmauth token brute-forcing, XSS in vmui) and cancels queries when the client disconnects.

item.title: Nextcloud Desktop 35.0.0
item.description: Nextcloud sync client for workstations. 35.0.0 (Oct 12) handles Adobe lock files and InDesign safe saving, fixes data loss when moving/renaming folders and drops QtWebEngine.

item.title: Warpgate 0.30.0 beta.1
item.description: Open source SSH/HTTPS/RDP/database bastion with session recording. The 0.30 beta (Oct 12) fetches passwords and keys from Vault/OpenBao, adds RDP Graphics Pipeline (RemoteFX) and mTLS between cluster nodes.

item.title: Defguard 2.2.0 beta1
item.description: Self-hostable WireGuard VPN with MFA and SSO. The 2.2 beta (Oct 12) allows multi-step MFA flows per site, FIDO2 keys as a factor, MFA setup after enrollment and bulk actions on the firewall.

item.title: Headplane 0.7.1
item.description: Web interface for Headscale (self-hosted Tailscale alternative): machines, users, ACLs, DNS, subnets, web SSH and OIDC SSO. Found via Self-Host Weekly (Oct 9 spotlight); latest version 0.7.1.

item.title: rclone 1.75.2
item.description: The sync and backup tool for S3, B2 and dozens of clouds ships a security release on Oct 9: token and B2 SSE-C key leak on redirect fixed, .rclonelink links escaping the root blocked, Go 1.26.9. Update it.

item.title: Technitium DNS Server 15.6.1
item.description: The self-hosted DNS server (cache, blocking, zones, DoH) ships a fix on Oct 11: LDAP auth StartTLS/LDAPS repaired, IXFR made reliable against Microsoft DNS and NOTIFY no longer misses secondaries. Good for the studio’s internal DNS.

item.title: Ventoy 1.1.18
item.description: The open source multiboot USB stick (just copy ISOs onto it, no reflashing) is out Oct 9: Windows/WinPE Secure Boot check fixed, ISO partition mountable for CloneZilla and experimental support for SteamOS recovery images. Handy for the deployment bench.

item.title: osquery 5.24.0
item.description: The open source agent that exposes your fleet as SQL tables (the basis of Fleet) ships a pre-release on Oct 9: heap overflow fixed in the Windows processes table, old TLS ciphers removed and a protector_types column for BitLocker.

item.title: Fleet 4.93.0
item.description: The open source device management platform (osquery, MDM) is out Oct 8: a “warn before patching” option for macOS apps, zero-touch Android enrollment and password rotation for the managed local account. Useful for keeping studio workstations up to date.

item.title: Netdata 2.12.1
item.description: The open source real-time monitoring tool ships a fix on Oct 8: no more crash when the Windows agent starts, eBPF collector stabilised on more kernels and reduced load on the Docker daemon. Handy for watching render nodes and servers.

item.title: Uptime Kuma 2.5.6
item.description: The self-hosted uptime monitoring tool (HTTP, ping, ports…) is out Oct 9 with security dependency updates and a fix for the average response time badge. A simple, recommended update.

item.title: OpenCue 1.34.22
item.description: ASWF’s open source render farm manager (released Oct 7) integrates Maestro, a new scheduler in Cuebot, a web UI on par with CueGUI and per-host limits driven by actual license usage. Database migrations: back up first.

item.title: Portainer 2.45.2 LTS
item.description: The Docker/Kubernetes management web UI ships a corrective LTS on Oct 8: a non-admin can no longer read host files via a Compose file, and TLS verification to the Kubernetes API is restored. Update recommended.

item.title: Montray 2.0.0
item.description: Small open source tool (BSD) that shows in the system tray the status of systemd services and command-line checks (disk, RAID…) across several servers, without a heavy monitoring stack. 2.0.0 (Oct 4) marks the rename (formerly Salmon).

item.title: TrueNAS 27 RC.1
item.description: First RC of TrueNAS 27 (formerly TrueNAS 26), released Oct 6: OpenZFS 2.4.4, kernel 6.18 and a native S3 service in early access, where each bucket is a ZFS dataset (snapshots, quotas, replication). Test on a lab NAS; stable expected early December.

item.title: sqi 0.3.0
item.description: Young open source render farm manager (AGPL) built on OpenJD, with Maya, Houdini, Nuke and Blender submitters. 0.3.0 (Aug 19) adds accounts, RBAC, LDAP/AD, OIDC SSO and running tasks under a dedicated account. Still being hardened.

item.title: FOG Project 1.6.0 RC-5
item.description: PXE disk image deployment, ideal for mastering artists’ workstations, nears 1.6: RC-5 (Oct 7) fixes a stuck MariaDB migration and approves all pending MACs in one click. The 1.5 → 1.6 upgrade is one-way: test in a lab.

item.title: Duplicati 2.4.0.1
item.description: Encrypted, deduplicated backup to NAS, S3 or cloud: stable 2.4.0.1 (Oct 7) makes restores more reliable (it continues if one file fails), as well as cancelling and the new sync mode, and hardens login and remote control, now Synology DSM compatible.

item.title: RustDesk 1.5.0
item.description: Open source, self-hostable alternative to TeamViewer/AnyDesk: 1.5.0 (Sept 30) adds a WebRTC transport, an ID allowlist, HDR tone mapping, clipboard sync between sessions and silent updates on macOS.

item.title: GLPI 12.0.0
item.description: Major release of the open source IT asset management and helpdesk tool, out Oct 7: rewritten knowledge base, tracking and revocation of open sessions, re-authentication for admin actions and per-group OLAs. Official Docker image.
